description: Paid ($0.003 USDC on Base, x402). Append a value under a key in the paying wallet's workspace. Agent memory: save a value under a key in a persistent key-value store owned by the paying wallet. The first write opens a 30-day workspace. Memory survives restarts, new machines and hand-offs between agents. Every write is hash-chained and signed (Ed25519), so the history verifies offline. Values up to 64 KB; failed writes are not charged.. Charged only if it succeeds. Call once without payment to get the price, then retry with params._meta["x402/payment"].

value.description: UTF-8 string; store JSON as a string
